status: source-only; no native or Node execution
conclusions: BuiltinLoader::LookupAndCompile selects six ordinary builtin parameters: exports, require, module, process, internalBinding, primordials.
internal/bootstrap/realm is itself compiled with process as its first parameter and is invoked from the actual Realm process object.
BuiltinModule.compileForInternalLoader calls the compiled ordinary builtin with its retained process parameter in position four.

Consequently process references in the selected internal/options and internal/util bodies resolve to this wrapper parameter. Replacing globalThis.process or installing a global lexical process binding cannot replace that captured parameter.

A selected-body fixture must retain the same actual wrapper parameter. The previous options projection omitted that parameter and its global-process-getter observations did not represent original Node execution.

selected_sources.role: Selected internal/options declarations separately pinned by the existing options source record; this wrapper packet does not assert a new local authority path.

limits: This packet establishes the process lexical binding only, not the full Node builtin loader, all primordial imports, or runtime qualification.
